notes.title: Development Update #1
notes.content:
I made big progress since my last devlog. In this little update, I want to introduce a new location to you:
[b]Your workplace[/b]. Here you will fill up your truck full of packages and prepare everything to be ready for your shift.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45230309/b5d527e0ba2369008281618806d8884d0567777f.png[/img]

I will soon upload "The first 5 minutes of Package Unknown" and also an improved Announcement Trailer so stay tuned (and wishlist the game now :D).
